decisions.reason: The accepted immediate post-mint tip transaction supersedes the candidate's prior requirement that the tip transaction be initiated only through a success-modal button without opening automatically.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
okay, i completed a mint using 'no referral code' with a '$1 tip'.

The mint required me to execute 1 transaction - 0xc92e17e9e7f26e6b4e03093ce35f6ed3d7fc135c8ee00bc77357eb082779f715

Immediately afterward, another transaction appeared for the tip - 0x887c21856bddc283cd444881931a1d14469cbbd49c2c2764e15855a9181af3b0

(We will need to add a UI note informing buyers that the tip transaction comes immediately after the mint transaction.)

Also, it may have been obscured by the tip transaction, but i did not see the 'mint successful' modal.

And there was no new commission or ticket counted on the leaderboard.

decisions.reason: The tipping transaction and its UI notice do not change how fiat buyers access commissions, tickets, prizes, or dashboard reward information.
The source concerns an optional tip after a completed mint and does not change the Transak provider, supported fiat methods, or fiat-to-mint behavior.
The source does not identify USDC or alter the required USDC wallet mint outcome; it only establishes separate post-mint tip execution and notice behavior.
A separate optional tip transaction does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited primary-mint supply model.
The source does not identify ETH or change ETH-to-USDC swap execution, its target amount, or excess-refund behavior.
The selected $1 tip is optional and separately transacted, so it does not change the required $15 primary mint price or its advertised price commitment.
The source does not allocate tip proceeds or revise the $15 primary-sale distribution among founder, affiliate, and prize pool.
The post-mint tip behavior does not change background wallet creation, custody, key control, or seed-phrase requirements for fiat buyers.
The source does not change which mint-payment currencies are disclosed or selectable; the tip is a separate follow-up transaction.
The source does not enable, disable, or change the selectability of ETH, USDC, card, or any other mint payment method.
The About page state contains no tipping-transaction instructions, and its statements about automatic reward delivery are not changed by a buyer's separate optional tip payment.
